name: Nayzviri & Lyudy
source:
Connections are different but there is one that occurs all the time for each of us, yet for many it is completely invisible.

Immerse yourself in a short story for 5-10 minutes and find out what kind of connection the main character Timo and You encounter.

[Translated from [url=https://yggdralogy.itch.io/naizviriandhumans]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
联系是不同的，但对于我们每个人来说，有一种联系一直存在，但对许多人来说，这种联系是完全看不见的。

让自己沉浸在一个短篇故事中5-10分钟，看看主角Timo和You遇到了什么样的联系。

[翻译自[url=https://yggdralogy.itch.io/naizviriandhumans]itch.io[/url]]
